ถ้าไม่ก็

Translation status: ภาษาไทย reader-locale proof. Term names and code fences follow the th-TH pack; supporting prose may still be English.

Adds an else-if branch after a previous ถ้า branch.

Aliases: else if

Syntax: ถ้าไม่ก็ <condition> <block>

Category#

control-flow

Related#

  • ถ้า
  • มิฉะนั้น

Examples#

radix/corpus/si/sin.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Adds an else-if branch after a previous ถ้า branch.

# =============================================================================
# ถ้าไม่ก็ — Adds an else-if branch after a previous ถ้า branch.
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Else-if chains — `ถ้าไม่ก็ <condition> { body }` adds intermediate conditional
#     branches between `ถ้า` and `มิฉะนั้น`
#   • First match wins: evaluation stops at the first `ถ้า` or `ถ้าไม่ก็` whose
#     condition is `จริง`
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • TODO: forgetting that `ถ้าไม่ก็` blocks are skipped once a preceding branch
#     matches
#
# See also: ถ้า, มิฉะนั้น
# =============================================================================

# si-sin-secus (poetic if-else-if chain)
#
# ถ้า <cond> { }
# ถ้าไม่ก็ <cond> { }
# มิฉะนั้น { }
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   ifStmt :← 'ถ้า' expr block ('ถ้าไม่ก็' expr block)* ('มิฉะนั้น' block)?
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   Afternoon (hour=14 matches first ถ้าไม่ก็ branch).

main {
    const int hour ← 14
    if hour ≺ 6 {
        print "Late night"
    }
    elif hour ≺ 12 {
        print "Morning"
    }
    elif hour ≺ 18 {
        # 14 ≥ 12 and 14 < 18
        print "Afternoon"
    }
    elif hour ≺ 22 {
        print "Evening"
    }
    else {
        print "Night"
    }
}

Expected output:

Afternoon

radix/corpus/sin/sin.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Adds an else-if branch after a previous ถ้า branch.

# =============================================================================
# ถ้าไม่ก็ — Adds an else-if branch after a previous ถ้า branch.
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Standalone else-if — `ถ้าไม่ก็` provides an intermediate conditional branch
#     evaluated only when the preceding `ถ้า` condition was `เท็จ`
#   • Chains: `ถ้า { } ถ้าไม่ก็ { } มิฉะนั้น { }` for multi-way branching
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Writing `มิฉะนั้น ถ้า` instead of the canonical `ถ้าไม่ก็` for else-if branches.
#
# See also: ถ้า, มิฉะนั้น
# =============================================================================

# ถ้าไม่ก็ — else-if branch
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   elseIfClause :← 'ถ้าไม่ก็' expr block
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   Scalar stdout smoke (see body).
#
# BACKEND:
#   Cross-ref: ถ้า/sin.fab.
#

main {
    const int score ← 85
    if score ≥ 90 {
        print "excellent"
    }
    elif score ≥ 80 {
        print "good"
    }
    else {
        print "needs work"
    }
}

Expected output:

good
